title: Paper House · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paper House · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Give the lead two sheets of paper and a clear table. The lead folds or rolls the sheets into a small freestanding structure with a recognizable roof. The structure stands unsupported for five seconds and the group recognizes a roof. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Two sheets of paper.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paper House, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The structure stands unsupported for five seconds and the group recognizes a roof.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The structure stands unsupported for five seconds and the group recognizes a roof.
